why: No repository URL or code link was provided, and the authors released no usable implementation to inspect. The match target C1 is nevertheless a small, well-specified CPU experiment: a regression tree on 7,211 QM7b molecules with 14 original properties. We can reimplement it from the paper using public QM7b data and standard scikit-learn regression trees.
missing_artifacts: author code for data loading, preprocessing, and regression-tree training
exact regression-tree implementation and hyperparameters (depth, pruning, min samples per leaf, etc.)
preprocessing details such as z-scoring and any target transformation
blockers_seen: no repository or code link was provided

feasibility.est_runtime_on_this_machine: a few minutes: download QM7b, load 7,211 x 14 features, fit and evaluate one regression tree

compute.basis: QM7b is only 7,211 x 14; a single scikit-learn regression-tree fit and evaluation takes seconds, dominated by package installation and data download.
